Name: Team(s)
Formula/Explanation: All teams the player has played for in the tier (ordered from most recent (at the top) to least recent (at the bottom)).

Name: Franchise(s)
Formula/Explanation: All franchises the player has played for in the tier (ordered from most recent (at the top) to least recent (at the bottom)).

Name: Conference
Formula/Explanation: The conference the player has played the most in.

Name: Stats-Based Value
Formula/Explanation: Standardize (Z-Score) NP/A, G/A, A/A, Sv/A, and S/A, then weighted-average them together, with their correlation to PWE serving as the weights.

Name: Total Shots
Formula/Explanation: The total number of shots taken by all players in all games the player was in.

Name: Games Played
Formula/Explanation: W + L

Name: Pythagorean Win Expectation
Formula/Explanation:
1 - 1 / (1 + (tm_G / opp_G) ^ ((tm_G/A + opp_G/A) ^ 0.287))
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pythagorean_expectation

Name: Win Percentage
Formula/Explanation: W / GP

Name: Non-Standard Points
Formula/Explanation: P - SP

Name: Shot Percentage
Formula/Explanation: Shot Percentage

Name: Points per Average
Formula/Explanation: P / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Standard Points per Average
Formula/Explanation: SP / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Non-Standard Points per Average
Formula/Explanation: NP / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Goals per Average
Formula/Explanation: G / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Assists per Average
Formula/Explanation: A / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Saves per Average
Formula/Explanation: Sv / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Shots per Average
Formula/Explanation: S / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Points per Game
Formula/Explanation: P / GP

Name: Standard Points per Game
Formula/Explanation: SP / GP

Name: Non-Standard Points per Game
Formula/Explanation: NP / GP

Name: Goals per Game
Formula/Explanation: G / GP

Name: Assists per Game
Formula/Explanation: A / GP

Name: Saves per Game
Formula/Explanation: Sv / GP

Name: Shots per Game
Formula/Explanation: S / GP

Name: Team Goals per Average
Formula/Explanation: tm_G / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Opponent Goals per Average
Formula/Explanation: opp_G / TS * (Average TS per Game in Tier)

Name: Team Goals per Game
Formula/Explanation: tm_G / GP

Name: Opponent Goals per Game
Formula/Explanation: opp_G / GP

Name: All-Star Eligibility
Formula/Explanation: Top 8 SBV in Conference (top 12 if tier has no Conference) with at least 60% of that tiers games played

Name: # All-Star Candidates
Formula/Explanation: Top 8 per Conference. Top 12 of the tier if it has no Conference.

Name: MVP Eligibility
Formula/Explanation: Need to be on a team with a record >=.500 or on a Playoff team and have 60% of that tiers games played

Name: # MVP Candidates
Formula/Explanation: Based on number of Teams that make Playoffs in each Conference, Min of 4, Max of 6
